user_role: palmux operator verifying workspace container isolation invariants on a real incus host
entry_point: PATCH /api/repos/{repoId}/branches/{branchId}/runtime (switch to incus-container) triggers container launch; observations made via `incus` CLI on the host + in-container exec
note: Infrastructure invariant Story. The end-user trigger is the runtime switch (API, also driven by the Header runtime chip in GUI); the new observable behavior (a dedicated palmux-shared profile + reconcile self-heal) is inspected on the host with incus. Real-mode only — run against deploy-test (192.168.1.43) real incus, never a fake.

scenarios.description: Switching a workspace to incus launches a container that references the palmux-shared profile instead of carrying per-container device adds
preconditions: a repo opened with a workspace on host runtime

steps.expected: profile exists; devices include ghq, dot-claude, dot-local-* etc (only sources that exist on host); no per-source Nix-store-symlink dotfile that points outside home

steps.action: host: `incus config show <inst>` and `incus config device list <inst>`
steps.expected: instance.profiles = [default, palmux-shared]; the shared devices come from the profile, NOT from instance-local device entries
prints the claude version (shared ~/.local + ~/.claude reached via the profile)

cleanup: switch workspace back to host runtime

scenarios.description: Reconcile self-heals a stripped profile on the next scan tick
preconditions: a workspace on incus runtime (scenario-1 done)

steps.action: host: `incus profile device remove palmux-shared ghq`
steps.expected: device removed; profile temporarily missing ghq
palmux's reconcile re-adds ghq to palmux-shared (device restored, converged to declaration)
ghq present again; full declared device set restored (idempotent convergence)

scenarios.description: A pre-existing per-container-device container migrates to the profile without losing auth/isolation
preconditions: a container that was created by the OLD per-container device-add path (or simulate by adding an instance-local device set)

steps.action: trigger a re-open / runtime re-attach so palmux applies the profile method
steps.expected: container ends up referencing palmux-shared; no duplicate/broken mounts; runtime.state=ready

steps.action: in-container: check hostname (isolation) + `gh auth status` + git rev-parse in ~/ghq/.../palmux2
steps.expected: hostname = container (isolated); gh authenticated as tjst-t; repo HEAD readable — parity with pre-migration

cleanup: switch workspace back to host runtime
